dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Linear trailing edge with zero curvature; strictly polygonal boundary from apex to posterior base intersection.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute vertex with minimal pixel radius; sharp angular point characteristic of low-poly rendering.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 40-degree linear incline relative to the horizontal dorsal midline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.5:1 ratio of maximum base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Flat profile with negligible curvature; melon boundary is defined by a single linear polygon segment.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, blunt beak projection; pixel length is approximately equal to its thickness at the base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 160 degrees at the rostrum-melon junction.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible faceted low-poly mesh topology; three parallel horizontal texture lines posterior to the ocular region; singular notch on the trailing edge of the primary pectoral fin.
